manual_impact_questions: Which user-visible outcome and protected behavior can change?
Which callers, state/data owners, error paths, migrations, and relaunch outcomes are affected?
Which notification, Widget, Intent, Watch, window, background, or other platform consumers share this contract?
Does an existing Oracle fail on a credible wrong value/state, or must the change add or strengthen one?

known_evidence_gaps: A changed test outside curated lanes may need an explicit focused invocation.
escalation_reasons: Test infrastructure changes require one representative product journey; syntax alone is insufficient.

minimum_evidence: Apple 100k Store/10k Watch correctness and provisional host ceilings
iOS prepared 1k Store launch-to-accurate-content purpose metric
fixed physical reference-device evidence when its explicit contract is available
known_evidence_gaps: Simulator and host evidence do not prove physical frame/hitch, APNs, background, or release trace behavior.
escalation_reasons: Performance test changes can silently weaken budgets, measured intervals, fixture scale, or accurate-content oracles.

known_evidence_gaps: Real APNs network delivery, permission denial, notification actions, terminated-process cold start, macOS, and physical-device behavior remain NOT RUN.
escalation_reasons: The system-notification harness can silently bypass SpringBoard, weaken exact payload checks, or stop proving durable product state.

minimum_evidence: one App-owned UI journey for each changed runtime
iOS/watchOS Release isolation builds and negative controls
escalation_reasons: Composition-root or Runtime changes cross storage and Release boundaries.

known_evidence_gaps: iOS controlled App-owned startup reliability is proven 50/50; macOS migration/startup UI remains blocked by local automation authorization and physical-device startup is not inferred.
escalation_reasons: The canonical Store is a shared state/data owner with cross-capability consumers.

minimum_evidence: encrypted notification success/failure/ACK semantics and canonical message persistence
known_evidence_gaps: Core tests prove semantic handling, not real APNs transport or SpringBoard presentation.
escalation_reasons: A changed ingress test must retain exact plaintext/error/ACK/store outcomes, not merely execute without crashing.

minimum_evidence: iOS provider refresh new-result/failure-recovery UI journeys
known_evidence_gaps: media and macOS UI remain incomplete; representative iOS pagination/read plus slow, new-result, and failure-recovery refresh workflows are protected.

minimum_evidence: projection semantics tests including out-of-order head rejection
iOS Event close/filter/relaunch and Thing accurate list/detail/three-relation/open/return/relaunch journeys
known_evidence_gaps: Event slow/error/duplicate-close recovery and Thing filters/deep links/delete outcomes are not yet fully protected.
escalation_reasons: Entity projections feed list, detail, Thing relations, notifications, and system surfaces.

minimum_evidence: channel/settings validation and injectable gateway service contract tests
real Settings page-visibility control and accurate destination journey
known_evidence_gaps: Channel accepted mutation, remote password rejection, and remote compensation for an explicit created=true result after local persistence failure have real-control journeys, as do page visibility, gateway validation rejection, local commit failure with successful rollback/restart/retry, server scoping, decryption lifecycle, protected-write failure, wrong-key correction, valid recovery, and corrupt-ciphertext safe failure. Candidate registration uses a fresh gateway-scoped identity without prepare mutation. Created=false/existing-channel ownership and idempotency, rollback-storage failure UI, macOS Settings UI, and notification-sound system behavior remain missing.
escalation_reasons: Credentials and remote/local reconciliation require failure and recovery evidence.

minimum_evidence: iOS Simulator real system-notification journey for iOS/shared route changes
known_evidence_gaps: Real APNs network delivery, notification center actions, permission denial/recovery, terminated-process cold start, and physical background execution remain NOT RUN.
escalation_reasons: Ingress changes cross extension, durable Store, notification, ACK, and App consumers.

known_evidence_gaps: physical Widget/Intent/Shortcut/Spotlight/Focus/Live Activity entry evidence remains NOT RUN.
escalation_reasons: System surfaces are independently failing consumers and cannot be inferred from the main App UI.

minimum_evidence: App-owned watchOS simulator UI journey with visible fields, delete cancellation/commit, and relaunch persistence
message Store failure remains owned by Messages while Event/Thing tasks stay usable
known_evidence_gaps: watchOS Messages/Event/Thing representative P0 UI and message-delete persistence are covered; mark-read mirror ACK, images/decryption, Receiver Health, physical notification route/receiver/complication, VoiceOver, and size matrix remain incomplete.
escalation_reasons: Watch is a separate Store/UI/system consumer and is promoted when shared contracts change.

minimum_evidence: macOS open/close/reopen UI evidence when available
known_evidence_gaps: The real close/status-item/reopen journey is implemented but macOS UI execution remains BLOCKED locally by automation authorization; physical status-item reachability is therefore NOT RUN until a controlled runner executes it.
escalation_reasons: Composition and window changes affect reachability of every downstream capability.

known_evidence_gaps: iOS zh-Hans accessibility5 message-detail/channel-create task and production localization completeness are covered. Physical VoiceOver, macOS/watchOS large-text tasks, media lifecycle, and notification sound system evidence remain incomplete.

escalation_reasons: Machine-consumed update metadata can prevent or misdirect user updates without changing App source.

known_evidence_gaps: Signing, notarization, install/upgrade, and distribution require the controlled Release environment.
escalation_reasons: Build and entitlement changes cross packaging, privacy, signing, and Release boundaries.
